item.title: Trump admin official says there’s a 'very good chance' gas prices will be back to normal by summer
item.summary: Department of Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Iran conflict will cause short-term gas price increases, but predicts normal prices by summer as Operation Epic Fury continues.

item.title: Americans know Iran is our enemy. It’s time establishment politicians agreed
item.summary: Iran funds terrorist groups like Hezbollah and Hamas and attacks U.S. forces, yet establishment Washington treats Tehran as diplomatic partner rather than threat.

item.title: US 'locked and loaded' to destroy Iran’s 'crown jewel' 'if we want,' Trump warns
item.summary: President Donald Trump says the United States is prepared to destroy Iran’s Kharg Island oil export hub but so far has chosen not to do so.

item.title: Adam Carolla pushes back after Joe Rogan says some Trump supporters feel 'betrayed' by Iran strikes
item.summary: Adam Carolla defends Trump's Iran strike decision against Joe Rogan's criticism, arguing the threat has been clearly defined through nuclear concerns and policy.

item.title: US warns Iraq must act against Iran-backed militia attacks on American assets

item.title: Google Gemini declares only GOP senators violate hate speech policy, zero Democrats, author claims
